comment: zap.c wish_history_add() (6235-6253) and wish_history_menu() (6288-6306) when an empty line follows a real wish. "dagger" fills slot 0; a bare Enter at the prompt is the empty line, which "dagger" is not a prefix of, so "" fills slot 1. The newest-first menu lists the blank entry as `a` and dagger as `b`. A line of spaces is emptied by mungspaces() and matches the stored ""; "elven dagger" matches it too and is not added, so the last menu is unchanged and `b` wishes for a dagger.
